A.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping and simplification)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM for two denominators
Solution rewrites fractions to equivalent forms with a common denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and subtraction proceeds directly
Work only rewrites a whole number as a fraction (without needing an LCD between two fractional denominators)

skills.name: Subtract fractional parts
skills.definition: Perform fraction subtraction once denominators match by subtracting numerators and keeping the common denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution subtracts numerators over a shared denominator (including producing 0 or a negative fraction)
Solution shows subtraction like a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b
exclusion_criteria: Only converts forms (e.g., to improper fractions or to common denominators) without actually subtracting
Only simplifies/reduces a fraction after subtraction without showing the subtraction operation

skills.name: Mixed/whole rewriting
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers or whole numbers into a form suitable for subtraction (e.g., improper fractions, or whole number as n 0/d or as an equivalent fraction).
inclusion_criteria: Solution converts a mixed number to an improper fraction (or interprets an atypical mixed number like 1 4/3 as a sum)
Solution rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with 0 fractional part or as an equivalent fraction with a chosen denominator
exclusion_criteria: Only borrows/regroups after a negative fractional difference (that is S04)
Only reduces/simplifies a fraction without changing representation type

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: When needed, borrow/regroup between whole and fractional parts to avoid a negative fractional part, and express the final answer in simplest appropriate form (reduced fraction, integer, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to fractional units (e.g., add d/d) to complete subtraction
Solution reduces a fraction to lowest terms and/or converts an improper fraction to a mixed number or to an integer at the end
exclusion_criteria: Only finds an LCD and converts fractions (S01)
Only performs numerator subtraction with like denominators (S02) without any regrouping or final-form simplification

B.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping and simplification)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM of denominators
Solution rewrites fractions to equivalent forms with a common denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed
Work only simplifies a fraction (e.g., 4/10 to 2/5) without creating a common denominator for subtraction

skills.name: Subtract fraction parts
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two fractions once they share a denominator (including cases that yield 0 or a negative fraction).
inclusion_criteria: Subtracts numerators over a common denominator (a/b − c/b)
Performs the fraction-part subtraction within mixed-number subtraction (e.g., 3/5 − 2/5, 4/12 − 7/12)
exclusion_criteria: Only converts denominators without performing the subtraction
Only simplifies/reduces a fraction after subtraction without showing the subtraction operation

skills.name: Mixed/whole rewriting
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers or whole numbers into a form suitable for subtraction (e.g., convert mixed to improper, or write a whole number as a mixed number with 0 fractional part or as an equivalent fraction).
inclusion_criteria: Converts a mixed number to an improper fraction (or interprets an atypical mixed number like 1 4/3 as 1 + 4/3)
Rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with 0 fractional part (e.g., 2 = 2 0/8)
Rewrites a whole number as an equivalent fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 4 = 12/3)
exclusion_criteria: Only subtracts whole parts and fraction parts without any rewriting step
Only reduces/simplifies a fraction (e.g., 9/12 to 3/4) without changing number form for subtraction

skills.name: Regroup and finalize
skills.definition: Regroup/borrow from the whole part when needed and express the final result in an appropriate simplified form (reduce, convert to mixed number, or to integer).
inclusion_criteria: Borrows/regroups because the fractional subtraction is negative (e.g., add 1 = b/b to the fraction and subtract 1 from the whole)
Simplifies the resulting fraction to lowest terms and/or converts an improper fraction to a mixed number or 0/1 to an integer as the final presentation
exclusion_criteria: Fraction subtraction does not require borrowing and no simplification/conversion is performed
Only performs common-denominator conversion or raw subtraction without any regrouping or final-form adjustment

C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping and simplification)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM of denominators
Solution converts fractions to equivalent forms with a common denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is performed
Work only rewrites a whole number as a fraction (tag S03 instead)

skills.name: Subtract fraction parts
skills.definition: Perform the subtraction once denominators match, typically by subtracting numerators and keeping the common denominator (including producing 0 or a negative fraction result).
inclusion_criteria: Subtracts two fractions with like denominators (a/b − c/b)
Subtracts the fractional parts of mixed numbers after aligning denominators
Produces intermediate results like 0/b or negative fractions (e.g., −3/12)
exclusion_criteria: Only converts to common denominators without subtracting
Only simplifies/reduces a fraction without performing subtraction

skills.name: Rewrite mixed/whole forms
skills.definition: Rewrite numbers into a form suitable for subtraction, such as converting mixed numbers to improper fractions or rewriting a whole number as a mixed number/fraction with a chosen denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Converts a mixed number to an improper fraction (e.g., 3 1/2 → 7/2)
Interprets a nonstandard mixed number with an improper fractional part (e.g., 1 4/3 → 7/3)
Rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with 0/n or as k/n (e.g., 2 → 2 0/8 or 4 → 12/3)
exclusion_criteria: Only finds LCD and converts proper fractions (tag S01 instead)
Only borrows/regroups after a negative fractional difference appears (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: Regroup/borrow between whole and fractional parts when needed and express the final answer in simplest appropriate form (reduce fractions and/or convert between improper fractions and mixed numbers/integers).
inclusion_criteria: Borrows 1 from the whole part to make the fractional subtraction nonnegative (adds b/b to the fraction)
Handles a negative fractional part by regrouping (e.g., −1/5 becomes (5/5−1/5) with whole reduced by 1)
Reduces a fraction to lowest terms and/or converts an improper fraction to a mixed number or integer for the final expression
exclusion_criteria: Subtracts fractions with like denominators without any regrouping or simplification beyond the subtraction (tag S02 instead)
Only performs common-denominator conversion (tag S01 instead)
